name: flybasis-mcp
description: Self-contained, keyless remote MCP connector shipped inside SpicyTool — web SERP via DuckDuckGo Lite with Wikipedia fallback, keyless DuckDuckGo/Wikipedia instant answers, and SSRF-guarded URL-to-clean-text/markdown fetch. No API keys, no RapidAPI proxy, no external upstream required. Exposes web_search / instant_answer / fetch_url to Claude/ChatGPT/any MCP client. (Award availability is a separate SpicyTool concern: backend/providers/flybasis.py over the Flybasis Socket.IO feed.)
